annotations.title: Switch an automation on or off

description: Switches an automation on or off. state "disable" is the emergency stop: it takes effect at once and needs no confirmation. state "enable" switches it on, and from then on it acts with nobody in the loop, so enabling happens only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it enables. version_id (enable only) picks the version to run; the default is the newest one, which has to have been checked and deployed first.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

state.description: enable to switch the automation on, disable to switch it off.

name: set_automation_state
title: Switch an automation on or off
